releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 292: Private Locker Lock Off now uses the PIN already verified on the control screen, then asks for a separate Lock Off confirmation. No second PIN prompt. Saved Locker entries remain preserved; Lock On and other controls remain unchanged.
